quit/confirm.original:
Close the game?
Unsaved progress will be lost.
quit/confirm.text:
Chiudere il gioco?
I progressi non salvati andranno persi.

net/rival_here.original: Your rival "{name}" is here! The match begins.
net/rival_here.text: Il tuo avversario "{name}" è qui! La battaglia inizia.

net/lobby_joined.original: You are in the lobby. Its screen opens from the main menu (Tenkaichi Budokai Online).
net/lobby_joined.text: Sei nella lobby. Puoi aprirla dal menu principale (Tenkaichi Budokai Online).

net/rival_from.original: Your rival "{name}" from {region} is here! The match begins.
net/rival_from.text: Il tuo avversario "{name}", da {region}, è qui! La battaglia inizia.

net/round_trip.text: Latenza di andata e ritorno: ~{ms} ms

update/ready.original: Update {version} is ready. F1 > Restart now.
update/ready.text: L'aggiornamento {version} è pronto. F1 > Riavvia ora.

update/online_off.original: An update is being installed: online play is off until the game restarts (F1 > Restart now).
update/online_off.text: È in corso l'installazione di un aggiornamento: il gioco online è disattivato fino al riavvio (F1 > Riavvia ora).

tbo/6ae97ea0.original: Fight whoever is searching right now! No time limit, and you can train while you wait.

tbo/db875bd2.original: Fights that move your rank, season by season. That one is coming soon!

tbo/a74ebfd6.original: A lobby for your friends: up to eight, your rules, rematches, spectators and tournaments!

tbo/2466fcbd.original: Got a lobby's code? Type it in to join, to play or to watch! By Address joins by the owner's address.

tbo/eefeab33.original: Your rivals, who is online, and invites. That one is coming soon!

tbo/eefeab33.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most), for the main list's entries

tbo/cb5f42f2.original: The Tenkaichi Budokai itself: brackets of 4 to 16 players. That one is coming soon!

tbo/cb5f42f2.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most), for the main list's entries

tbo/517e7f66.original: Your last matches, saved to watch again. That one is coming soon!

tbo/517e7f66.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most), for the main list's entries

tbo/cbebde6d.original: The strongest in the world, among your friends, and with each fighter. Coming soon!

tbo/cbebde6d.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most), for the main list's entries

tbo/9f977205.original: The lobby's owner removed you from the lobby.
tbo/9f977205.text: Il proprietario ti ha rimosso dalla lobby.
tbo/9f977205.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/acf04ad5.original: The connection to the lobby's owner was lost: the lobby is closed.
tbo/acf04ad5.text: Connessione al proprietario persa: la lobby è chiusa.
tbo/acf04ad5.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/cfe30adb.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/db43c724.original: The lobby owner's game is a different version: joining needs the same release.
tbo/db43c724.text: Il proprietario ha un'altra versione del gioco: serve la stessa per entrare.
tbo/db43c724.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/d29ae0f1.original: The game at that address is a different version: joining needs the same release.
tbo/d29ae0f1.text: Il gioco a questo indirizzo ha una versione diversa. Per unirti serve la stessa versione.
tbo/d29ae0f1.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/803ae285.original: Someone with another version of the game tried to join.
tbo/803ae285.text: Qualcuno con una versione diversa del gioco ha tentato di unirsi.
tbo/803ae285.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/5f1d5850.original: The lobby owner's game data are not the same as yours (a modified disc image or mods on one side): you cannot join.
tbo/5f1d5850.text: I dati del proprietario sono diversi dai tuoi (immagine disco modificata o mod): non puoi entrare.
tbo/5f1d5850.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/d343b038.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/0ffe55c2.text: Impossibile aprire una connessione di rete.
tbo/0ffe55c2.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/d3075a80.original: Lobbies need the game's state list (the .mem file beside the program): copy all the files of the release.
tbo/d3075a80.text: Le lobby richiedono l'elenco dello stato (il file .mem accanto al programma): copia tutti i file della versione.
tbo/d3075a80.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/b14d7b08.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/d4c50b23.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/97b5e3f1.original: No winner: the match will be played again.
tbo/97b5e3f1.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/79b937db.original: The players' results differ: the match will be played again.
tbo/79b937db.text: I risultati dei giocatori sono diversi: l'incontro verrà rigiocato.
tbo/79b937db.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/4a76e9ef.original: Only one player's result came: the match will be played again.
tbo/4a76e9ef.text: È arrivato il risultato di un solo giocatore: l'incontro verrà rigiocato.
tbo/4a76e9ef.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/e97830bb.original: The two games disagree on this match: the owner chooses the winner.
tbo/e97830bb.text: I due giochi non concordano su questo incontro: il proprietario sceglie il vincitore.
tbo/e97830bb.note: a line of the lobby: what happened, or why it closed (talk box or a window)

tbo/6a9b02d5.original: The host's game data are not the same as yours (a modified disc image or mods on one side): you cannot watch this match.
tbo/6a9b02d5.text: I tuoi dati di gioco sono diversi da quelli dell'host (immagine modificata o mod su un lato). Non puoi guardare questa partita.
tbo/6a9b02d5.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/dc75af5c.original: This match already has as many spectators as it can take (6).
tbo/dc75af5c.text: Questa partita ha già il numero massimo di spettatori (6).
tbo/dc75af5c.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/74e44163.original: The host does not let anyone watch its matches.
tbo/74e44163.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/5dda5287.original: This match cannot be watched (it was not started from the online menus).
tbo/5dda5287.text: Non puoi guardare questo incontro perché non è stato avviato dai menu online.
tbo/5dda5287.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/c59d3e7e.original: That is the address of the player who joined, not of the host: spectators connect to the host.
tbo/c59d3e7e.text: È l'indirizzo del giocatore che si è unito, non dell'host. Gli spettatori si collegano all'host.
tbo/c59d3e7e.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/b272b73f.original: This match is a lobby's: join the lobby (its code, or its owner's address) to watch it.
tbo/b272b73f.text: Questa partita appartiene a una sala. Unisciti con il codice o l'indirizzo del proprietario per guardare.
tbo/b272b73f.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/c5f78375.original: The host's game is a different version: watching needs the same release as the host's.
tbo/c5f78375.text: L'host ha una versione diversa del gioco. Per guardare devi avere la stessa versione.
tbo/c5f78375.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/430f233b.original: No answer from the host. Check the address and port. Watching a match needs a release newer than 0.1.38.7 on the host as well (an older host does not answer spectators).
tbo/430f233b.text: L'host non risponde. Controlla indirizzo e porta. Per guardare, anche l'host deve avere una versione successiva alla 0.1.38.7; le precedenti non rispondono agli spettatori.
tbo/430f233b.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/e62c73bf.original: Your game data and the other player's are not the same (a modified disc image or mods on one side): an online match needs the same on both.
tbo/e62c73bf.text: I tuoi dati di gioco sono diversi da quelli avversari (immagine modificata o mod su un lato). Per giocare online entrambi devono avere gli stessi dati.
tbo/e62c73bf.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/e584114e.original: Too many have asked to watch that room in the last two minutes; try again soon.
tbo/e584114e.text: Troppe richieste per guardare questa sala negli ultimi due minuti. Riprova tra poco.
tbo/e584114e.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/b3551db3.original: No room with that code, or the matchmaking service does not take spectators yet. (Codes last ten minutes; a host on 0.1.38.7 or older gives its room up when the match begins.)
tbo/b3551db3.text: Nessuna sala con questo codice, oppure il servizio non supporta ancora gli spettatori. I codici durano dieci minuti; un host con versione 0.1.38.7 o precedente abbandona la sala all'inizio della partita.
tbo/b3551db3.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/9c7b74fe.original: The matchmaking service could not be reached (is the network up?).
tbo/9c7b74fe.text: Impossibile raggiungere il servizio di abbinamento. La rete è connessa?
tbo/9c7b74fe.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/fe0b1da7.original: Too many wrong codes from this address; try again in an hour.
tbo/fe0b1da7.text: Troppi codici errati da questo indirizzo. Riprova tra un'ora.
tbo/fe0b1da7.note: a table of the online menu

tbo/855d984e.original: No code: the others type your address and this port on Join by Address. Left / right, L1 / R1 change it.
tbo/855d984e.text: Senza codice: gli altri inseriscono il tuo indirizzo e questa porta in Unisciti tramite indirizzo. Sinistra/destra o L1/R1 la cambiano.
tbo/855d984e.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/2180d35d.original: Your lobby gets a code: give it to your friends, they type it on Join. Set the rules on its page!
tbo/2180d35d.text: La sala riceve un codice: condividilo con gli amici, che lo inseriscono in Unisciti. Imposta le regole nella sua pagina!
tbo/2180d35d.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/457366cb.original: Enter the lobby's code, or Paste the one they sent you! Then Join: to play, or to watch from the stands.
tbo/457366cb.text: Inserisci il codice sala o incolla quello ricevuto! Poi Unisciti: per giocare o guardare dagli spalti.
tbo/457366cb.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/b3934c83.original: Type the lobby owner's address, and :port if it is not 7000. Then Join!
tbo/b3934c83.text: Inserisci l'indirizzo del proprietario e :porta se non è 7000. Poi Unisciti!
tbo/b3934c83.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/73f9fb75.original: Here we go! The match is starting!
tbo/73f9fb75.text: Ci siamo! La battaglia sta iniziando!
tbo/73f9fb75.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/b648dc56.original: Looking for a worthy challenger... Warm up in Training meanwhile!
tbo/b648dc56.text: Ricerca di uno sfidante degno... Intanto riscaldati in Allenamento!
tbo/b648dc56.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/c40519d7.original: Sorry! Quick match is for the game straight off the disc. Modded? Play your friends in a lobby!
tbo/c40519d7.text: Le partite rapide usano i dati originali del disco. Hai delle mod? Gioca con gli amici in una sala!
tbo/c40519d7.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/dda980c6.original: Warm up at the tournament while we search! Pick yourself and a sparring partner.
tbo/dda980c6.text: Riscaldati al torneo durante la ricerca! Scegli il tuo combattente e un compagno.
tbo/dda980c6.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/164ea733.original: Auto: rivals near you first. A region: players there first, everyone after 40 s. Anywhere: the fastest.
tbo/164ea733.text: Auto: prima i vicini. Regione: prima i suoi giocatori, tutti dopo 40 s. Ovunque: il più rapido.
tbo/164ea733.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/3d4a10f0.original: Pick a battle and we'll find you a rival! No time limit, and the game runs a little faster.
tbo/3d4a10f0.text: Scegli la battaglia e troveremo un avversario! Senza limite di tempo e con il gioco un po' più veloce.
tbo/3d4a10f0.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/9c852db4.original: Pick your letters, then Done! Square deletes, Start finishes.
tbo/9c852db4.text: Scegli le lettere, poi Fatto! Quadrato elimina, START termina.
tbo/9c852db4.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/546717fa.original: Show everyone who you are! This is the name your rivals see.
tbo/546717fa.text: Mostra chi sei! Questo è il nome che vedranno i tuoi avversari.
tbo/546717fa.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/a05d46e9.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/50826afb.original: Opening your lobby! The others join it with your address.
tbo/50826afb.text: Apertura della tua sala! Gli altri si uniranno con il tuo indirizzo.
tbo/50826afb.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/7fc1879f.original: Opening your lobby! The others join it with its code.
tbo/7fc1879f.text: Apertura della tua lobby! Gli altri entrano con il codice.
tbo/7fc1879f.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/27f5b2ac.original: You are out of that lobby. OK takes you back to the online menu.
tbo/27f5b2ac.text: Sei fuori dalla lobby. OK ti riporta al menu online.
tbo/27f5b2ac.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/4d44665c.original: Type a line for everyone in the lobby, then Done! Start sends it too.
tbo/4d44665c.text: Scrivi un messaggio per tutti, poi Fatto! Anche START lo invia.
tbo/4d44665c.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/43b56798.original: Welcome to the lobby! Its owner picks who plays and starts the match. Chat while you wait!
tbo/43b56798.text: Benvenuto nella lobby! Il proprietario sceglie i giocatori e avvia la battaglia. Chatta nell'attesa!
tbo/43b56798.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/3b6ac746.original: Tournament: Entrants sets the player places. Move people into them (you too, to play), then Start Tournament!
tbo/3b6ac746.text: Torneo: Partecipanti imposta i posti dei giocatori. Sposta le persone (anche te, per giocare), poi premi Avvia torneo!
tbo/3b6ac746.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/63451d36.original: Your lobby is open! Give the others its code: they type it on Join. Then put two of you in 1P and 2P.
tbo/63451d36.text: La sala è aperta! Condividi il codice con gli altri, che lo inseriscono in Unisciti. Poi metti due persone in 1P e 2P.
tbo/63451d36.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)

tbo/8cd4aa37.original: Your lobby is open! The others join with your address and port (Join by Address). Then 1P and 2P.
tbo/8cd4aa37.text: La sala è aperta! Gli altri si uniscono con indirizzo e porta (Unisciti tramite indirizzo). Poi 1P e 2P.
tbo/8cd4aa37.note: talk box at the foot of the screen (two lines at most)
